Phase-8 placement-rebuild INPUT, RE-DERIVED AT HEAD (v5-perf @ e023b0e, the minima contact fix: filter A `minima_drop_interior_faces` + refined filter B `minima_require_island_birth` AND `minima_support_area_tips`). SUPERSEDES acceptance-run-2026-07-23/phase8_relocation_input.json, which is keyed to the PRE-fix contact set (state v5e_run1.pkl, md5 aab04cf3...): dropping phantom inner-wall minima and inadequately-carried minima removes 195 of 753 contacts and REINDEXES every downstream member, so every member id in the old snapshot is invalid here. The old file is retained UNCHANGED as the archived-forest regression pair (scripts/tests/test_phase8_driver.py cross-checks it against v5e_run1.pkl; scripts/tests/test_p11_fixture.py reads it for ruling-1A provenance).
Same two populations, same ratified predicate (SCAR-AREA-CAP A_ABS_MM2=2.0 / KAPPA=1.25 / L_SCAR_MAX_MM=2.5, rule-4 through-transit, PRINT-FLOOR strict chord < 0.08mm moot downgrade, quarantine REAL/ARTIFACT regrade), same tools, same order:
 (A) relocation_targets: the RAW-predicate condemned-stub re-grade -- 39 sites, 39 REAL / 0 ARTIFACT. Every one of the 39 is a geometric survivor of the old 77-REAL set (matched on (p0,p1,r0,r1,kind,embed_end) to 1e-4mm); NO site changed verdict and NO new site appeared. The old 3 ARTIFACTs (437/440/444, tip-anchored LEGAL deep plugs) are gone with their contacts, so the ARTIFACT bucket is empty here -- not a regrade flip.
 (B) printfloor_partition: the census's 109 illegal live members split into 72 NON-EXEMPT hard violations (rebuild) vs 37 MOOT sub-0.08mm knife-edges (report-only, never gated). The moot/non-exempt split is the census's OWN full-precision `moot` flag, so the mi=420-class rounding artifact that forced the 2026-07-24 CORRECTION on the old snapshot cannot recur; no member sits within 1e-4mm of the 0.10mm band edge either.
Verdict stability across the fix: of the old 143 non-exempt, 81 member geometries are GONE and all 62 survivors are STILL non-exempt; of the old 50 moot, 17 are gone and all 33 survivors are STILL moot. Zero flips in either direction. The 10 new non-exempt and 4 new moot members have no surviving old counterpart -- they are re-routed geometry (removing contacts changes rewire/brace routing), not newly-broken old members.

relocation_targets.artifact_note: Empty at HEAD: the old ARTIFACT trio 437/440/444 (single tip-anchored LEGAL deep plugs) lost their contacts to the minima fix. Every surviving quarantine site regrades REAL, exactly as it did before the fix.

printfloor_partition._doc: PRINT-FLOOR classification of the census's 109 illegal members (SPEC-EMBED-POLICY PRINT-FLOOR amendment, OWNER RATIFIED 2026-07-24). A member is MOOT iff ALL its rule-4 crossings have chord (feature_thickness) < 0.08mm STRICTLY; else NON-EXEMPT (hard gate). A SCAR-illegal tip interval is a rules-1-3 failure, never moot-eligible. Derived from results/penetration_census.json (144 crossings / 109 members).

ball_breaches._doc: INFORMATIONAL (phase8.load_frozen_snapshot takes ball breaches from the caller's live census, not from this file). Census antipodal-span true breaches, ball indices into the run's ball list; equal in count to the engine gate's own ball_breach_violations (R3 census-parity).
